title: Icefields Parkway Discovery from Calgary, end Jasper
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Passengers are allowed a maximum of 2 pieces of luggage per person

If you require a wheelchair lift bus, at least 72 hours’ advance notice is required. Please contact us by phone or email through our official website and provide the dimensions and weight of your wheelchair or scooter at booking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Travel from Calgary to Jasper on this one-way Canadian Rockies day trip by coach, ideal for photographers, outdoor enthusiasts and casual sightseers alike. Explore Banff National Park and Jasper National Park, and travel along the Icefields Parkway, one of Canada's most scenic drives. You'll visit sights including Lake Louise, Crowfoot Glacier and Peyto Lake, and ride the Ice Explorer on the Columbia Icefield. Admire waterfalls and glaciers, and enjoy lunch on this full-day tour ending in Jasper.
